en: A monochrome, vintage view of a narrow medieval street with steep‑roofed houses and a tall, slender Gothic tower rising behind them. The tower has a long, tapering spire topped with a weather vane. The houses have stepped and curving gables, many-paned windows, and tile roofs; small figures walk along the street at the bottom of the image. The overall style suggests a historic European town scene. No visible caption or printed text is present on the front.
